Package com.nexuslink.protocol.db

Class SqlQueryBuilder

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.db.SqlQueryBuilder
public final class SqlQueryBuilder extends Object
Pure, dialect-agnostic assembler for a SELECT statement. Feed it a table, an optional column list, a set of WHERE conditions combined with AND, an optional ORDER BY and an optional LIMIT; it returns a well-formed SQL string.

Identifiers (table + column names) are double-quoted and internal quotes doubled; string values are single-quoted and escaped, while numeric literals are emitted bare. This class holds no database state, so it is trivially unit-testable and drives the visual query builder UI.
